cross_model_key_findings: Team uplift is universal across all 6 closed models (+3.6pp to +32.1pp)
Weaker models benefit MORE: Haiku 4.5 achieves 4x relative gain vs 2x for Sonnet 4.6
Teamwork is an equalizer: Haiku 4.5 matches Sonnet 4.6 on Full condition (both 42.9%) despite 2x lower Oracle
Full > NoVerify > NoPlan > Oracle for 4/6 models — verification adds value for closed models
Open-source models (0-2.1%) fail due to tool-use infrastructure, not capability: 73-76% context overflow for larger models, 31-43% bad attestation for smaller ones
GPT-5 Nano is the weakest closed model but still benefits from teamwork (+3.6pp)
paper_implications: Section 5: Cross-model analysis shows teamwork benefit is model-general, not model-specific
Section 6: Open-source gap is infrastructure (context window, tool-calling), not intelligence
